lab_questions.title: Fix Production API Latency Caused by an N+1 Query Problem
lab_questions.description: A backend service in Django REST Framework is suffering from severe performance degradation under load. Read through the codebase, identify the intentional N+1 query regression, and optimize the ORM execution to reduce SQL queries to an absolute minimum.

tasks.title: Identify the performance bottleneck
tasks.description: Analyze the `/api/orders/` endpoint and find the exact lines in the serializer and views causing the N+1 database queries.

tasks.title: Optimize the Django ORM queries
tasks.description: Modify the view's queryset using `select_related` and `prefetch_related` (or `Prefetch`) so that the endpoint fetches all necessary customer, product, and category data efficiently.

tasks.title: Verify optimizations via tests
tasks.description: Run the performance test suite via pytest to verify that the query count has successfully dropped to 3 or fewer queries, passing the strict performance threshold.
